title: Code Quality and Static Analysis knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which topic is explicitly listed in the syllabus coverage for “Code Quality and Static Analysis”?
questions.explanation: The attached FastAPI syllabus lists “Formatting and linting” under this lesson. The remaining syllabus subtopics are preserved in the lesson file for complete coverage.

questions.prompt: According to the worked example in “Code Quality and Static Analysis”, which result should the learner verify?
options: pytest reports one passing test when saved as a test file and pytest is installed.
The app publishes itself to production and passes all tests automatically.
HTTP 500 is returned for every valid request.
Input validation and authorization are disabled by design.
questions.answer_key: pytest reports one passing test when saved as a test file and pytest is installed.
questions.explanation: The worked example explicitly documents this expected result. Reproduce it locally in the listed environment before treating it as tested behavior.

questions.prompt: Which test strategy provides stronger evidence? (Code Quality and Static Analysis)
options: Cover normal, invalid, authorization and missing-resource paths with isolated fixtures/mocks
Assert only that the process starts
Call a live payment or production database from every unit test
Mark tests passed without running them
questions.answer_key: Cover normal, invalid, authorization and missing-resource paths with isolated fixtures/mocks
questions.explanation: A suite that covers both expected results and failure cases is more useful and reliable than a startup-only smoke check.
